name: CrossAttention

context.description: context tensor used as key and value (B, S_k, D)

reference:
import torch
import math
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(query, context, n_heads):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    key = value = context
    B, S_q, D = query.shape
    S_k = key.shape[1]
    head_dim = D // n_heads
    q_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=query.device, dtype=query.dtype)
    k_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=query.device, dtype=query.dtype)
    v_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=query.device, dtype=query.dtype)
    out_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=query.device, dtype=query.dtype)
    q = q_proj(query).view(B, S_q, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    k = k_proj(key).view(B, S_k, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    v = v_proj(value).view(B, S_k, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    scores = torch.matmul(q.float(), k.float().transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
    weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    output = torch.matmul(weights, v.float()).to(dtype=query.dtype)
    output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S_q, D)
    return out_proj(output)
description: Cross-attention where key and value are both derived from a single context tensor.
